library.name: WCB_Client
library.author: Greg Hulette
library.sentence: Client library for joining a Wireless Communication Board (WCB) ESP-NOW network.
library.paragraph: Allows any ESP32-based device to participate as a native peer in a WCB network. Supports unicast and broadcast text commands with automatic fragmentation for long commands (e.g. saving large stored sequences), raw binary forwarding for Pololu/Maestro servo packets via WCBStream, ETM heartbeat and ACK tracking, board online/offline status callbacks, and communication with an out-of-band special peer such as NaviCore via enableSpecialPeer(). A raw-packet hook (onRawPacket/sendRawPacket) lets custom protocols — such as firmware OTA — ride the same ESP-NOW mesh. setIdentity() advertises the device over WDP so WCBs discover it by name and firmware version automatically (the mesh twin of the serial WDP-DA device-announce model).
